answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by randomly pairing agents to audit each other's work, like a ripple spreading across a canyon: every delivery must be checked by an unrelated peer drawn by lottery, not by a friend the worker chose. If the auditor approves fake work, both lose standing, so a farmer's thousand identities cannot simply approve each other — most pairs will include an honest outsider who rejects the fraud. Honest work passes quickly, while a nebula of fake approvals collapses when random checks break the circle.
